summary: EAROS iteration 2 verified end-to-end. Backend: 41/41 pytest tests passing (29 iteration-1 regression + 12 new iteration-2). Frontend: all 12 new/updated pages render with expected data-testids; post-login lands on /mission (not /dashboard); Mission Control shows 8 KPIs, 17 agent pulse cards, ambient-ticker, pending approvals with review links, running executions, recent reflections. Interactive flows verified: scenario-run for scn.java_chennai completes with LIFECYCLE COMPLETE summary; POST /api/intake/analyze (Claude Sonnet 4.5) returns generated JD/must-have skills in ~45s; What-If sliders live-update trajectory chart + AI decision card. Regression pages (/dashboard, /recruiter, /governance, /world, /capabilities, /policies, /planner) still render. All 7 EAROS invariants (LLM never bypasses policy, immutable events, auto reflection, policy gating of low-confidence + offers, candidate-safe view, auth redirect) verified via backend tests. No critical bugs.

issues: Console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Root cause is the Emergent dev-time visual-editor tracer injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> tags for dynamic text — not authored code. Cosmetic dev-only warning; selects work correctly. Safe to ignore in production build.
Two /api/auth/me 401s logged before login (expected — protected routes probe session on mount). Benign.

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/mission/snapshot returns counts + agent_pulse (17) + ambient_activity + recent_events + running_executions + pending_approvals — exactly per spec.
GET /api/platform/agents returns 17; /api/platform/integrations returns 24; /api/scenarios returns 8 — counts match design.
POST /api/scenarios/scn.java_chennai/run drives runtime + policy_engine + governance + reflection (verified: correlation_id + candidates_screened; UI shows LIFECYCLE COMPLETE).
POST /api/intake/analyze: LLM path succeeds in ~45s with Java must-have + generated JD populated; deterministic fallback documented as valid outcome (source='fallback').
POST /api/simulate/what-if returns trajectory with exactly 13 points + recommendation reasoning — chart re-renders on slider move.
GET /api/outreach/pack returns 3 email variants nested under channels.email_variants (documented for future tests).
POST /api/screening/rubric returns 8-dimension rubric + composite band — human-readable throughout the UI.
GET /api/sourcing/sweep/{job_id} returns 10 channels each with matches/unique_matches/quality_score/latency_ms/confidence — matches spec.
Iteration-1 regression: 29/29 pytest tests still pass; all policy invariants intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_earos_v2.py — 12 tests for mission/agents/integrations/scenarios/intake/sourcing/resume/outreach/screening/voice/what-if. Iteration-1 suite still valid. Note response shape gotchas discovered: outreach pack has email_variants nested under 'channels'; screening returns 'rubric' key (not 'dimensions'); sourcing channels use 'quality_score' + 'unique_matches' (not 'quality' + 'unique'). Intake LLM can take up to 90s — timeout accordingly. Scenario run takes ~5-20s. Hydration <span> in <option> warning is Emergent visual-editor instrumentation, not a real bug.
